description: This file contains implementation of naive dilated convolution functions, including CPU-based volume-to-column conversions, shape checks, forward and backward passes for 2D and 3D dilated convolutions. It defines template functions for volume-to-column transformations, shape validation, and convolution computations, along with their dispatch registration.
